original_test_intent: Run every approved UFM Fabric Validation cable check and prove each expected cable/path property passes or has a specifically investigated and dispositioned warning.
original_method: Snapshot fabric identity/topology/alarms and UFM version; load an approved ordered checklist of exact Fabric Validation items; select and run each item once; capture status, detail, affected GUID/port/cable and report ID; stop on fabric-impacting or unknown checks; correlate warnings with physical/counter evidence; leave final disposition to the fabric owner.
manual_activity: Fabric owner supplies the approved checklist and dispositions; operator verifies physical cable/LED/label evidence when a warning identifies a link.
required_inputs: Ordered 'Check xxx' list and release-specific semantics
safety_requirements: Do not invoke topology deployment or corrective actions
Stop on mutating/unknown item or new critical fabric alarm
Preserve raw reports and logs; no auto-retry or log clearing

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic UFM UI access fits only at a high level; subnet-merger risk is unrelated and no check enumeration is provided.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run only the release-matched approved Fabric Validation items, one at a time, and export each report/status/detail before advancing.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All source 'Check xxx' items and center-pane PASS/warning behavior are retained; omitted item names remain pending.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a versioned item-to-expected-status matrix and immutable UFM report IDs, with physical mapping for every warning.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact checklist scope, release identity, per-item oracle, topology mapping and hold/escalation rules.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A single overall PASS cannot substitute for every left-bar item or its warning details.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: UFM validation catalogs vary by release; an unknown item can be misinterpreted or may trigger actions beyond a read-only cable check.

project_override_considerations: Owner must define which checks constitute NV cable validation, allowed warning exceptions, required report fields and whether any check is disruptive or maintenance-only.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek's subnet-merge/topology-deploy risk is copied and unrelated to this per-item cable validation; Master and GPT V2 consistently require UFM Fabric Validation checks.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution remains gated by exact check semantics, topology identity and warning acceptance.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row422 Wistron-L12 Cluster-00471-V003: approve UFM version/fabric identity, complete ordered Fabric Validation 'Check xxx' list, per-item PASS/warning oracle and exceptions, GUID/port/cable map, disruptive-item holds and warning escalation/disposition.

review_improvement: Replaces an unnamed click-through with a traceable per-check cable validation ledger.
independent_technical_reasoning: The UI's aggregate status cannot prove cable coverage because each check can target a different physical or logical property. A warning is meaningful only when its report detail is tied to the correct GUID, port and labeled cable and assessed against an approved exception policy.
